results.title: Human creativity still surpasses “creative” generative AI, according ...
results.content: * **Research shows that generative AI models perform poorly in creative image production, especially when deprived of human guidance.**. As a result of this workshop, the researchers articulated an innovative methodology to study creativity: they prepared a visual-creative imagination task based on abstract stimuli and **compared the creative performance of an AI image generation model, with and without human guidance, with that of two groups of people: visual artists and general population**. Secondly, by showing that as human guidance decreased, so did the creativity of the models, the study highlighted “that **current image-generation models are still far from reproducing independent creative processes**”, says Dr. Antoni Rodríguez-Fornells, head of the Cognition and Brain Plasticity group at IDIBELL-UB, ICREA researcher, and co-leader of the study.
